dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: Good question. I've been asking myself why I needed all these rugs.

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: But Sulaykha would talk my ear off every time I went to the Grand Bazaar, and I'd come back with several rugs in tow...

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: She made a lot of sense on how each rug was useful...

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: But it's a different story when I get home.

dialogues.speaker: Aftab
dialogues.text: I don't know why I just couldn't stop buying them!
